end session NAME and its tmux server: claude exits as when its terminal closes,
and what claude started through tmux ends too

Usage:
  cld kill [-n NAME] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help        help for kill
  -n, --name NAME   the session NAME: up to 64 letters, digits, "_" and "-",
                    starting with a letter or digit (default "main")
